plain: The act of freeing an enslaved person

webster.text: The act of liberating a slave from bondage, and giving him freedom.

example.quote: We ought to possess them in the manner we inherited them from our ancestors, as their manumission is incompatible with the felicity of our country.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 24, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
